// Relative paths use the root source directory. Returned storage belongs to run.context.
fn host_path(run: *RmdRun, path: *u8) -> *u8 {
    if path == null(*u8) || path[0usize] == 0u8 {
        rmd_set_error((*run).context, (*run).source, (*run).cursor, "input path is empty");
        return null(*u8);
    }
    var size: usize = 0usize;
    while path[size] != 0u8 { size = size + 1usize; }
    if path[0usize] == 47u8 { return rmd_try_copy_string((*run).context, path, size); }
    var base: *u8 = (*(*run).source).path;
    var prefix: usize = 0usize;
    var index: usize = 0usize;
    while base[index] != 0u8 {
        if base[index] == 47u8 { prefix = index + 1usize; }
        index = index + 1usize;
    }
    if size >= (~0usize) - prefix {
        rmd_set_error((*run).context, (*run).source, (*run).cursor, "input path is too long");
        return null(*u8);
    }
    var result: *u8 = rmd_try_alloc((*run).context, prefix + size + 1usize, 1usize);
    if result == null(*u8) { return result; }
    index = 0usize;
    while index < prefix { result[index] = base[index]; index = index + 1usize; }
    index = 0usize;
    while index <= size { result[prefix + index] = path[index]; index = index + 1usize; }
    return result;
}

// Capture one input with the caller's declaration identity. Keep run.context live
// until all contexts that borrow this source have been destroyed.
fn host_input(run: *RmdRun, path: *u8, identity: u64) -> *RmdSource {
    var resolved: *u8 = host_path(run, path);
    if resolved == null(*u8) { return null(*RmdSource); }
    var result: *RmdSource = rmd_try_alloc((*run).context, sizeof(RmdSource), alignof(RmdSource)) as *RmdSource;
    if result == null(*RmdSource) { return result; }
    (*result) = make RmdSource { path: resolved, bytes: null(*u8), size: 0usize, identity: identity };
    var bytes: *u8 = null(*u8);
    var size: usize = 0usize;
    if rmd0_host_read_file(resolved, &bytes, &size) != 0i32 {
        rmd_set_error((*run).context, result, 0usize, "cannot read source input");
        return null(*RmdSource);
    }
    var copy: *u8 = rmd_try_copy_string((*run).context, bytes, size);
    rmd0_host_free(bytes);
    if copy == null(*u8) { return null(*RmdSource); }
    (*result).bytes = copy;
    (*result).size = size;
    return result;
}

// Add and check one complete host declaration set. Functions in it can refer
// to each other. Return false with a retained diagnostic on failure.
fn host_source(run: *RmdRun, path: *u8) -> bool {
    if (*run).next_identity == ~0u64 {
        rmd_set_error((*run).context, (*run).source, (*run).cursor, "host source identities are exhausted");
        return false;
    }
    var captured: *RmdSource = host_input(run, path, (*run).next_identity);
    if captured == null(*RmdSource) { return false; }
    (*run).next_identity = (*run).next_identity + 1u64;
    var unit_value: *RmdUnit = null(*RmdUnit);
    if !rmd_read((*run).context, captured, &unit_value) { return false; }
    return rmd_run_check_unit(run, unit_value);
}

// Load native code from a root-relative path. Keep it live through root completion.
fn host_link(run: *RmdRun, path: *u8) -> bool {
    var resolved: *u8 = host_path(run, path);
    if resolved == null(*u8) { return false; }
    return rmd_run_link(run, resolved);
}
